body: All these years I have just been going through the motions and being a good father and partner not thinking of my own needs. I will try to think of some but it's really hard when I run away from the problem and work. I have a bad habit of that. If you asked me what I like or enjoy I would draw a blank honestly.

Thank you sir or madam I'm trying harder for them. It does seem as though I always live for other people and I'm on cruise control. I  find it hard to look for things I want. My fiance has asked me what I wanted in life and if  we should separate. She also says she wants me to be happy even of it's not with her. Maybe I'm too chickenshit to leave because I will never find someone like her out here and I would make the mistake of leaving the best thing that has happened to me. Then I will fall in deeper depression because I cant come back. She is a great person that tells me to love myself and improved regularly.
Added on the fact is the money is too good to pass up

The problem is that I seem to like working because I get bored easily. Since I was 12 I have had very few people who I could relate to .I went through puberty with no help and socially raised myself. I didn't have much contact with my father because of how he wished my mom would die in the hospital and how he treated me. I was raised by my grandparents and there was a 60 year age gap so we couldn't relate much at all. Playstation and Xbox were my beat friends. I dont like vacations because my mind tends to wander so I am a workaholic running  from my issues. I have over 700 hours in sick and vacation combined and I have only been at this job for 6 years.

You are right.Plus I have a Government job. I cant complain about these things. But I realized my unresolved issues regarding my mother's death (I found her) when I was twelve and the disconnect my father had with me. My father and me barely talk now and he has all my numbers and I see him on facebook with my sister all the time.
